visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a white hoodie with pink drawstrings stands in a bright indoor studio-like environment, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) In a bathroom setting, a woman with short dark hair in a white long-sleeved shirt with a cartoon bear logo is seen brushing her teeth with an electric toothbrush; the man peers in through the open doorway in the background. (3) The man is in a modern white kitchen, meticulously chopping green zucchini slices on a yellow cutting board and placing them into a white air fryer. (4) Close-up shots show the man plating the cooked zucchini with sliced chicken breast and halved soft-boiled eggs on a green-rimmed plate. (5) The man presents the breakfast plate and a light blue mug with a sloth illustration to the woman, who is now seated at a wooden dining table; pink heart graphics float above the mug. (6) Returning to the studio background, the man holds up two fingers while talking to the camera. (7) The woman is sitting on a gray cushion on the floor of a living room, huddled with her legs pulled up, watching a television screen that is partially visible; the man approaches her holding a black tablet. (8) Close-up of the tablet screen displaying menu options in Chinese, followed by shots of the man massaging the woman's shoulders while she reacts emotionally. (9) Back in the studio, the man holds up three fingers; then he is seen entering a house through a large glass-paned door, carrying a brown shopping bag. (10) Detailed product shots of a purple and silver gift box featuring a star design and individual red foil packets of chicken essence being handled and heated in a pot of water. (11) The woman and man are shown opening the packets and drinking the liquid; the man holds a small ceramic cup. (12) The man stands before the studio background again, holding the large purple gift box and pointing to promotional text overlays before concluding the video.
